name: site-footer
title: Site Footer
description: A marketing footer: an empty logo slot and uppercase statement, titled link columns, then the copyright line, legal links and social buttons. Lime tone for marketing pages, plain dark tone for in-app pages.

meta.use_when: You are closing a landing, pricing or tool page and need links to the rest of the site, legal pages and social accounts; use the plain tone for a small footer on app pages
